$comment: Sprint 09 owned: one event of the SUPPORTED V1 assignment-ledger compatibility variant (v1Version '1.0'). The variant is a deterministic, documented reconstruction of the known V1 evidence classes (docs/v1-characterization.md, docs/worker-contract.md section 2) — it is NOT claimed to be the byte format of any private BL-020 archive; artifacts that differ fail clearly as UNSUPPORTED_LEGACY_VARIANT. Events chain: prevDigest is the digest of the previous event (GENESIS = 64 zeros for seq 1); digest = sha256 over the canonical JSON of the event excluding its own digest field. The reader VERIFIES the chain read-only and NEVER rewrites or repairs it; a broken chain fails deterministically. Kind-specific requirements (ASSIGNMENT needs assignment, HANDOFF needs response, CONTROLLER_ACTION needs action) are enforced in src/compat/v1/ledger.mjs because the Sprint-00 engine has no if/then. Public-safe: bounded fields only — no secrets, no raw model output; error paths never embed event bodies.
